EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows hallmark features of a terminal vinyl group: an exceptionally strong band at 999 cm⁻¹ with a companion band at 906 cm⁻¹, and a C=C stretch at 1639 cm⁻¹. It also matches a monosubstituted benzene ring (out-of-plane C–H bands near 703 and 785 cm⁻¹, plus strong ring modes at 1597 and ~1000 cm⁻¹). The 703 cm⁻¹ band is consistent with an aryl C–Cl stretch. No NH/OH stretches appear near 3300–3600 cm⁻¹, disfavoring amide/acid candidates. Overall, these features fit C=C[C@H](Cl)c1ccccc1 best.
